resources.string: Saathi helps your parent use their phone, one spoken step at a time. Setup takes 2 minutes.

Saathi reads the text on the screen and takes a picture of it only when the Help button is pressed or while it is guiding a task. These are sent to Saathi\'s server to decide the next step and are not stored. Saathi never taps anything itself, and it cannot see PIN or payment screens.
In Settings, open \"Downloaded apps\" or \"Installed apps\", choose Saathi and turn it on.
If the switch is greyed out, open App info, tap ⋮ at the top and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".
In any app, press the orange \"Help\" button and say what you want to do. For example: \"I want to order milk on Blinkit\".
I could not hear you. Press Help and speak again.
The internet is not working. Please try again in a little while.
First, please allow the microphone for Saathi.
Careful! This app lets a stranger control your phone. If someone on a call asked you to open it, close it now and call your family.
This part you do yourself. Never tell this number to anyone, even on the phone.
Saathi looks at the screen and tells you out loud what to press next. It never presses anything itself.
